purpose: 把固定查询覆盖与业务证据充分性分开；允许上游评估缺口并提出增量查询，同时由请求方或下游业务 Owner 保留验收、增量授权和最终解释权。

applicability.boundary: 真实研究须有原任务明确的实际完成要求，不能只有模式名称。简单直接读取由本工程依据用户原始请求记录目标、停止条件和原请求引用，无需用户另批豁免。

behavior_boundaries: 真实研究检索未声明策略时默认启用 D-237；缺少 acceptance_mode 时返回 d237_consumer_contract_required
简单直接读取由本工程依据原用户请求记录适用性，不索取额外豁免；有复杂研究要求时仍检查充分性
完成固定查询数或固定样本数不自动证明业务充分
proposed_incremental_batch 必须 needs_downstream_authorization=true 且 live_channel_authorized=false
approved_incremental_batch 必须有 adaptive_extension 授权和数量、时间、成本边界
增量授权不替代微信或小红书 Owner 预检、共享 GUI lease 或 live Gate
单次命中只能成为 candidate；跨至少两个真实任务有效且经真人批量接受后才能 recommended
candidate 阶段不要求逐条人工审批
真实学习记录与业务样本不得进入公开发行 fixture
content_supply_gap 只描述当前平台、当前查询批次和当前语义，不能外推为全网没有

completion_claim_policy.scope: Use only requirements explicit in the original business task; owner maps them into the existing contract without inventing quotas or scores.
completion_claim_policy.count_threshold: Hard minimum; count_target is aspirational and does not block completion.
completion_claim_policy.quality_criteria: Required qualitative conditions; optional improvements stay outside this list.
completion_claim_policy.diversity_requirements: Hard coverage conditions; diversity_targets are aspirational.
completion_claim_policy.cumulative_evidence: For a sufficient claim with numeric or object requirements, list task-qualified evidence_item_id references, including reused material. Duplicate identities count once. Add project_or_brand_id, source_id, source_role or object_id only for applicable coverage requirements.
completion_claim_policy.requirement_assessments: Existing receipt mapping from each required quality criterion or other qualitative requirement to met plus an evidence-based basis. No quality score; the model assesses substantive support.
completion_claim_policy.partial_delivery: A truthful partial receipt remains deliverable. A contradiction rejects only the sufficient claim. Do not infer criticality from remaining_gap prose.
completion_claim_policy.marginal_gain: assessment and assessment_basis are sufficient unless the business contract explicitly requires marginal_gain_fields. Absent means unmeasured or inapplicable, not zero.
